Risk.description: We're responsible for enabling the business by managing risks and maintaining controls that ensure trust in the platform.

Legal.description: We analyze complex and novel legal issues for Plaid to enable innovation.

Sales.description: We work with prospective customers to help them navigate and evaluate our solutions so that any business can become a fintech.

Design.description: We bring ideas to life, serve as the voice of our users, and create a meaningful and unified Plaid experience.

People.description: We make Plaid the highlight of your career.

Finance.description: We enable Plaid’s sustainable growth by providing financial insights and raising capital to invest in our business.

Product.description: We evaluate what to pursue, craft strategies to maximize impact, and help teams deliver market success.

Security.description: We enable Plaid to quickly build safe and secure products while ensuring that Plaid's users, data, and infrastructure remains protected.

Marketing.description: We reach, engage, and inspire innovators to build with Plaid.

Recruiting.description: We build the company by hiring each and every future employee into Plaid.

University.description: We engage with university students and promote early career opportunities across the company.

Engineering.description: We build simple yet innovative consumer products and developer APIs that shape how everybody interacts with money and the financial system.

Partnerships.description: We build long-term relationships to accelerate the growth and reach of Plaid’s products across the financial ecosystem.

Communications.description: We share stories about how Plaid and the fintech services we power make money easier for people around the world.

EPDS Operations.description: We accelerate and simplify the delivery of products through systems, processes, and program management.

Product Support.description: We support the next generation of financial services by investigating, escalating, and fixing the issues affecting our customers and our consumers.

Financial Access.description: We work with the industry to enable consumers to connect to their favorite services and lead healthier financial lives.

Account Management.description: We partner with customers to help them build and scale the best applications on top of Plaid.

Business Operations.description: We ensure cross-functional coordination and increase efficiency across Plaid to help us achieve our Company goals.

Business Development.description: We build the global partnerships within financial services that enable the supply side of Plaid’s platform.

Workplace Experience.description: We build and maintain an inspiring and inclusive employee experience at Plaid.

Corporate Development.description: We evaluate and facilitate product partnerships, investments, and acquisitions to expand Plaid’s products and business.

Professional Services.description: We work with customers to help them build and scale the best applications on top of Plaid.

New Product GTM & Commercial.description: We work with prospective customers to help them navigate and evaluate our solutions so that any business can become a fintech.

Financial Institution Partnerships.description: We work with the industry to enable consumers to connect to their favorite services and lead healthier financial lives.

Compliance.description: We ensure Plaid meets regulatory requirements and industry standards so we can build products that earn and keep our customers’ trust.

GTM Operations.description: We power Plaid’s growth by streamlining go-to-market strategy, tools, and processes across Sales, Marketing, and Customer teams.

Policy.description: We advocate for smart policy and regulation that supports innovation, consumer control, and a more open financial ecosystem.

Product Marketing.description: We connect customer needs to product solutions by shaping positioning, launching products, and enabling teams across Plaid.
